docs.tchar: printable minus the three delimiters, per position.

source:
## Inline markup: bold, italic and code inside plain text. The
## alternation orders the longer delimiters first (** before *), and
## code's body excludes backticks — so the spans split deterministically.
grammar Markup version "1.0.0" edition "v2" {
  nl = %x0A
  ## printable minus the three delimiters, per position.
  tchar = %x01-09 / %x0B-2A / %x2C-5E / %x60-10FFFF
  plain = *tchar
  bold = "**" 1*( %x01-09 / %x0B-29 / %x2B-5E / %x60-10FFFF ) "**" as bold
  italic = "*" 1*( %x01-09 / %x0B-29 / %x2B-5E / %x60-10FFFF ) "*" as italic
  code = "`" 1*( %x01-09 / %x0B-5F / %x61-10FFFF ) "`" as code
  inline = *( bold / italic / code / tchar )
  ws = %x20 / %x09
  pq = *ws
  line = pq inline pq nl
  doc = *( line )

  entry main: doc

  test {
    accept "plain text\n"
    accept "this is **bold** and *italic* and `code`\n"
    accept "**a *nested-looking* b**\n"
    accept "no markup here\n"
  }
}
